newsitem.title: EU: EUROSTAT RELEASES INFORMATION ABOUT ACCOUNTING PRACTICES.
newsitem.headline: EUROSTAT RELEASES INFORMATION ABOUT ACCOUNTING PRACTICES.

text.p: Please note the following addition to the Reuter EC Report diary for Friday, February 21:

BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Eurostat releases information about the accounting practices of EU member states trying to meet the convergence criteria for a single currency, including Italy's "Eurotax" (1200/1100 GMT).
